name: Vehicle state
note: A CANbus Export we define (D-378); bytes 1-2 are bitfields the PMU builds with math channels

name: Power
on_timeout: blank the voltage field, never hold

name: Outputs
note: Bytes 0-1 were fuel level until D-306; reserved now. Bytes 2-4 are a bitfield built by math channels (D-378)

name: Per-channel current
note: Multiplexed, all 24 channels in ~5 s - unproven in a CANbus Export (D-378): F-009 proves it or makes it fixed frames

name: Engine sensors
on_timeout: ICU-local — this is its own message
note: The frame that must not depend on anything

name: Body / slow
on_timeout: blank the fuel field; the PMU logs a received-channel fault
note: Added D-306; oil pressure stays in 0x200 so it outranks fuel on the bus — priority is per frame

name: Battery - pack and cells 1-2
on_timeout: blank the battery fields; the PMU logs a received-channel fault
note: Pack voltage from the BMS advertisement, cells from the type-01 frame, via the ICU's ESP32-C3 (D-267, D-330, D-345). Telemetry only (D-251)

name: Battery - cells 3-4 and spread
note: The spread is derived on the ICU (D-345)

name: Battery - current, SoC, temperature
note: Defined so the shape exists; never transmitted while the fields have no source - not as zero, not as 0xFF

name: Climate
on_timeout: climate display shows —; the blower is unaffected, its final stage is on a local wire
note: Byte 1 became duty %, byte 5 outside-air temp (D-307 / D-308)

name: Panel keys
note: Sent by the DCU on the panel's behalf - the panel has no CAN node (D-210 → D-355). Ten keys in bytes 0-1, held ≥ 1 s in bytes 2-3 (F-016). On change plus a 2 Hz heartbeat, so a receiver can time out to 'all released' if the DCU dies mid-press; the PMU acts on defog, hatch and fuel door (edges), the windows are the DCU's own outputs

name: AFR (AEMnet)
on_timeout: blank AFR on the cluster; the PMU logs a received-channel fault
status: confirmed from AEM's 30-0300 sheet (electrical D-266); that the fitted gauge is a 30-0300 is confirm — electrical B2
note: 29-bit extended ID 0x00000180 (menu ID 1; ID 2–16 = 0x181–0x18F), DLC 8, big-endian, no internal termination — the two exceptions to D-086 / D-106; valid = byte 6 bit 7 set and byte 7 bit 6 clear
